title: True Black Concrete
description: For when your black concrete isn't dark enough.
body:
True Black Concrete gives concrete a darker look while keeping the vanilla textures. Compatable with many resource packs.

How to install
 - Download True Black Concrete according to the version you use
 - Open file explorer
 - Copy or move the .zip file to C:\Users\{USER}\AppData\Roaming\.minecraft\resourcepacks

If using with another resource pack:
- Move the loaded resource pack above the resource pack you are using with it

[True Coloured Concrete](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/true-coloured-concrete)
